name: Web Search via Executa
description: Demonstrates the web/search + web/fetch + web/image_search + web/image_fetch reverse-RPCs — the host owns provider keys, SSRF guarding, quota and billing; the plugin just asks. Backed by the web.search / web.fetch / web.image_search / web.image_fetch capabilities.
_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish`; the dev fields (tool_id/type/enabled) are read by `anna-app dev`. This dir is the `web-search-via-executa` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas. Only a `local` distribution profile is declared — add a `binary` profile (PyInstaller + GitHub Release URLs, see the file-upload demo for the shape) before shipping to users whose agents can't run `uvx`. web/* needs `anna-app dev` signed in; the dev install seeds a fully-enabled web_grant so no manual Permissions toggling is needed in dev.
